set.body:
The repo does not lack an intake vocabulary. It has a careful, unforgeable, receipt-carrying one, and most of it is unreachable, while the working code routes around it with literals, a forged film edition, and per-corpus Python forks. One pattern, ten instances (D1-D10 in the plan).

Measured 2026-09-17 against main 0df1d9e7:
- MappingRelation, TrackComposition, EditionCorrespondence, OccurrenceId: ZERO references outside core/source.scala:1268-1465, including tests.
- ClockRepair (exact-rational affine clock map whose no-repair overload always returns Left "cannot enter without a declared repair"): no production caller, two core test suites only.
- SourceBundle.of (:1018) is public and accepts SourceKind.AnnotationTable, but has zero callers and demands a PresentationAxis; every axis constructor is kind-specific, so no axis for a non-edition kind can be minted and `of` can never be satisfied for AnnotationTable.
- Consequence: FilmFestivalRecallMapping.scala:148-168 forges EditionId("filmfestival-annotation-<sha>-<part>") for a corpus with no admitted video, its own Scaladoc saying "This is deliberately not a film edition".
- No code reads any docs/data/*/source-manifest.json.
- The Sherlock crosswalk exists three times; SherlockAnnotationsSuite.scala:188-199, a test NAMED for timebase-repair.json, never opens it and asserts Scala literals against Scala literals.

Approach: readers first, vocabulary as forced by real corpora. Do not design the standard first -- revision 1 of this plan specified six vocabulary families before opening a workbook and was rejected at n=0.

Vetted in three independent passes (rev1: 4 blockers; rev2: 3 defects + 2 false claims in the diagnosis; rev3: 3 high-severity contract holes both earlier passes had ACCEPTED). Recurring failure shape: a carrier named "verified"/"known" whose status is publicly constructible.

Related, not duplicated: bd-01M17ZNXY6AS1CMBQJRH3JMNVX (Mirror.fromProduct forgeability in align) and bd-01M199ABAG5SXR9C6Y0G4X6J2T (movie time and mapping contract).

Nothing here admits a corpus, commits a Friends artifact, or changes any inference, default or published number.
set.title: EPIC: annotation intake contract -- make the dead intake vocabulary reachable and wire the records to code
